cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CES5102, destination Beijing, 4800m maintaining, estimating DOGAR05, information F, now contact Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是东方5102，目的地北京，保持4800米，预计到达DOGAR时间为05分，通播F，现在联系北京进近。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES5102, 4800m maintaining, estimating DOGAR05, information F.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，东方5102，保持4800米，预计到达DOGAR时间为05分，通播F。

cards.audioText: CES5102, Beijing Approach, DOGAR03 arrival, expect ILS approach runway 01, maintain 4800m.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，北京进近，DOGAR-03进场，盲降进近跑道01，保持4800米。
cards.referenceText: DOGAR03 arrival, expect ILS approach runway 01, maintain 4800m, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: DOGAR-03进场，预计盲降进近跑道01，保持4800米，东方5102。

cards.audioText: [Flight attendants reported that a loud noise is coming from the backward right of the cabin, report this to the controller and request emergency descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【空乘人员听到客舱右后方一声巨响，把这一情况报告给管制员，请求紧急下降。】
cards.referenceText: (Mayday Mayday Mayday) Beijing Approach, CES5102, we have a loud noise coming from the cabin, request emergency descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: （Mayday Mayday Mayday）北京进近，东方5102，我们听到客舱内一声巨响，请求紧急下降。

cards.audioText: CES5102, descend to and maintain 2100m on QNH 1012.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，下降并保持2100，修正海压1012。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 2100m on QNH 1012, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持2100，修正海压1012，东方5102。

cards.audioText: CES5102, can you describe the sound in more detail?[It seems to be an outside air noise or a slight depressurization problem.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，可以具体描述一下那声巨响么？【似乎是外部空气噪音或轻微失压问题。】
cards.referenceText: It sounds like an outside air noise or a slight depressurization problem, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 听起来像是外部空气噪音或是轻微失压造成的，东方5102。

cards.audioText: CES5102, roger.[The engineers advised that it may be a problem with the door seal. They suggested you reduce speed to minimum, report to the controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，收到。【工程师说可能是舱门密封有问题。他们建议将速度降至最低，报告给管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES5102, maybe a problem with the door seal. The engineers suggest we reduce speed to minimum.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，东方5102，可能是舱门密封有问题。工程师建议减速至最低。

cards.audioText: CES5102, affirm, do you require emergency service on arrival?[You have three passengers injured during emergency descent, so you will need medical service on arrival, require priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，同意，到达时需要紧急服务么？【紧急下降时有三名乘客受伤，所以到达时你需要医疗服务，并请求优先降落。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we have three injured persons during descent. Request priority landing and require ambulance on arrival, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，下降时有三名乘客受伤。请求优先降落，到达时需要救护车，东方5102。

cards.audioText: CES5102, roger, you are number one, doctors and ambulance will be ready on arrival. [Request change runway 36R to save time.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，收到，你第一个，到达时医生和救护车都将准备好。【为了节省时间请求更换至36右跑道。】
cards.referenceText: No.1, request runway change to 36R, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 第一个，请求更换至36右跑道，东方5102。

cards.audioText: CES5102, Beijing roger, turn left heading 300, radar vector for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，北京收到，左转航向300，雷达引导降落。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 300, radar vector for landing, ES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向300，雷达引导降落，东方5102。

cards.audioText: CES5102, the weather is deteriorating, say intentions. [Tell the controller you want to continue approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，恶劣天气状况，请示意图。【告诉管制员你想继续进近。】

cards.audioText: CES5102, descend to and maintain 900m, turn right heading 330, report established on localizer.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，下降保持900米，右转航向330，建立航道报告。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 900m, turn right heading 330, report established on the localizer, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持900米，右转航向330，建立航道报告，东方5102。

cards.audioText: [Report established on localizer 5 miles final RWY 36R.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【跑道36右五边5海里航向道建立后报】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES5102, established on localizer 5 miles final runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，东方5102，跑道36右，五边5海里航向道已建立。

cards.audioText: CES5102, continue approach and contact Beijing Tower 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，继续进近，联系北京塔台118.1。

cards.audioText: [Report to Tower that you have established ILS.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告知塔台你已经建立了盲降。】
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，东方5102，建立盲降。

cards.audioText: CES5102, Beijing Tower, expect low visibility for your arrival, say intention.[You want to try landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，北京塔台，机场低能见，请示意图。【你想尝试降落。】
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求着陆， 东方5102。

cards.audioText: CES5102, continue approach, report outer marker.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，继续进近，过远台报告。

cards.audioText: CES5102, cleared to land runway 36R, surface wind 160, 7m/s, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，可以着陆，跑道36右，地面风160，7米/秒，脱离后报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 36R, report vacated, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以着陆，跑道36右，脱离后报告，东方5102。
